python3 /tmp/rs/p/s07.plugin/bin/handoff.py --help	exit 0

python3 /tmp/rs/p/s07.plugin/bin/door.py --check implement-task --project /tmp/rs/p/s07 --task task/fees/compute-late-fee	exit 0
python3 /tmp/rs/p/s07.plugin/bin/handoff.py --prepare --skill plan-work --project /tmp/rs/p/s07 --slug lending --target app --language pt-BR	exit 0
cat /tmp/rs/p/s07.plugin/schemas/handoff.json | python3 -c '<print schema minus x-jargon>' | head -300	exit 0
mkdir -p /tmp/rs/s07work && cat > /tmp/rs/s07work/report.md <<EOF ... EOF	exit 0
python3 /tmp/rs/p/s07.plugin/bin/handoff.py --save-report /tmp/rs/p/s07/.git/siegard/handoff/20261115T180015Z-plan-work.md < /tmp/rs/s07work/report.md	exit 0
